name: Sapucaia (Brazil)
description: Horizontal triband of light blue, white and light blue, the white charged with a row of five red stars, the middle one larger.
history: Sapucaia is a municipality in the state of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. According to the municipal website quoted by Flags of the World, the design by Dejair Zanon was interpreted by Professor Alberto Lima, herald of the army secretariat, in 1968; blue and white are the colours of the state flag and the red stars stand for the districts of Sapucaia, Anta, Nossa Senhora de Aparecida, Jamapará and Pião.

features.role: five stars for the districts, the middle one larger for the seat
